_about: Written name -> how voice D should SAY it (Mikey, 4 Nov 2026). make.py swaps these into a line's spoken text when the line has no `say` field; captions always show the written `text`. Longest names are swapped first, and a name followed by 's keeps it. How to write a respelling: plain English syllables joined by hyphens, the stressed syllable in capitals, lowercase when it is only two letters (voice D reads 'UR' or 'EE' alone as letters), and never start with 'um' or 'uh' (it is read as a hesitation). Sources: Wikipedia's IPA for each person or club (listed in `_ipa`), else the club's or broadcasters' usage. Check a new entry by making a line with it and transcribing it. | 4 Nov 2026: voice D pauses at hyphens and spells capitals, so every respelling is ONE joined word per name word, first letter capital only (e.g. 'Soolay', 'Onree'). These were auto-joined from the old hyphen style and are NOT all verified: transcribe a name through voice D before trusting it, then fix the entry here.
